title: Species
description: What a monster is, dominated or not (#45, #72). One file per species, named after its id.

type.description: A type from the type chart (#68).

id.description: Stable, never reused: lowercase words joined by underscores.

name.description: What the player reads (#351); code and saves use the id. One invented word, never a description (#717).

codex.description: Its bestiary entry (#959, #1173): what the player reads on its codex page once they've learned it.

entry.description: Its lore: a short text about it and where its name comes from, shown once the player has dominated one.

gloss.description: What its name means, hand-written (#959), e.g. "the low boom from the shallows".

types.description: One or two types from the type chart (#68), never two of the same family.

strike_type.description: Its auto attack's type (#626), whatever fits it, not necessarily one of its own.

speed.description: Base speed, a whole amount (#33, #222): higher is faster.

special.description: Its special attack, an ability of kind special that no other species has (#222, #228).

player_passive.description: Its passive that helps the player while it's out, an ability of kind player_passive (#222).

self_passive.description: Its passive that helps itself, an ability of kind self_passive (#222).

behaviour.description: Its behaviour traits (#1200), which its monsters' daily schedule is made from (owner's ground rule, #1199): exactly one sleep rhythm (diurnal, nocturnal, cathemeral: awake and asleep in bouts through day and night, or sleepless: never asleep), at least one need (grazer: eats grass now and then, drinker: walks to the nearest water now and then, predator: roams in search of weaker or grazer monsters), and optionally its instincts to band together (pack_species: with its own species, pack_type: with monsters of the same or similar typing).

sight.description: Its sight trait (#962): how many steps further a player who carries it sees. None when left out.
